looks.label: Fixture render modes
looks.technique: a category table: each category has a renderer (none, shaded, flat or image), a light ramp by direction, a colour, a transparency and a shadow record

looks.label: River types as an enum with a separate lava class
looks.technique: river, lake, swamp and lava as enum members, so lava reads as a hazard and not as water

looks.label: Leaf-mask canopy
looks.technique: one leaf-mask texture gates a flat canopy card; not read in pixels

looks.label: Faction landmark variants
looks.technique: three landmark renders share one footprint and differ by ornament; not read in pixels

originals.name: Terrain-first world map
originals.idea: A minimap and world map drawn from terrain height and water, not hand-placed shapes.
originals.keep: the map comes from terrain data
originals.change: our own colour key and a fog-of-war edge; the terrain-and-water claim comes from AU034 and is not re-checked here

originals.name: Landmark style table
originals.idea: One small table gives every map landmark a render mode, light ramp and shadow.
originals.keep: one table styles every landmark category
originals.change: our own categories (keep, shrine, gate, camp) and our own shadow values

originals.name: Lava band
originals.idea: Lava as its own hazard class of river, reading as danger rather than water.
originals.keep: a distinct hazard class in the river enum
originals.change: a slow glowing band with a crust and an audio tick; our own texture

originals.name: Faction keep landmark
originals.idea: One tall, centred landmark silhouette across factions; the faction shows by ornament and tint.
originals.change: our own roof and arch; faction colour by tint only

originals.name: Leaf-mask canopy card
originals.idea: A mask texture on a flat card: cheap at scale and readable at distance.
originals.change: our own leaf shape and a sway rule
